content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Pittsburgh

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—no prior work experience necessary. This makes CAPM ideal for career-changers and early-stage professionals entering Pittsburgh's competitive job market. Verify your educational background meets PMI standards before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format compresses the required project management education into a focused schedule, allowing you to earn your hours without disrupting work or family commitments while preparing for exam success.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your education hours, submit your PMI application and pay the associated exam fee directly to the Project Management Institute. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the submission process to ensure accuracy and timely approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review PMBOK® Guide concepts and test-taking strategies. You'll sit for the proctored CAPM exam on a schedule that fits your readiness, with support available to address final questions.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM certification remains active for three years. Throughout your renewal cycle, earn professional development units by attending training, conferences, or volunteering on project work. Renewal keeps your credential current and demonstrates ongoing commitment to the profession.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.

CAPM certification is a reasonable differentiator in these sectors, particularly for professionals entering or advancing within these industries.
